reports.title: Humana Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results;

lines: •Raises FY 2026 Adjusted EPS guidance to now be 'at least $9.50', up from the previous expectation of 'at least $9.00'; while revising GAAP EPS guidance to 'at least $15.09', up from the previous estimate of 'at least $6.52'

Humana revises its GAAP EPS guidance for the year ending December 31, 2026 (FY 2026) to 'at least $15.09' from 'at least $6.52', while raising its Adjusted EPS guidance to 'at least $9.50' from the previous guidance of 'at least $9.00'.

desk.headline: Revenue up 26% to $41.2bn, adjusted loss of $0.70 a share smaller than feared; full-year adjusted EPS guide raised to at least $9.50
results: Revenue rose 26% to $41.2bn on Medicare membership growth and higher premiums, partly offset by the lower 2026 Star Ratings bonus.
On an adjusted basis Humana lost $0.70 a share (vs a $3.24 profit a year ago) but beat the -$1.03 estimate; GAAP EPS was $1.33, lifted by a non-cash $1.2bn put-liability reversal.
The insurance benefit ratio of 93.7% was better than the company's own guide of slightly above 94%, but the Insurance segment still lost $303m in the quarter.
The operating cost ratio improved to 11.3% from 12.6% on cost cuts and scale; CenterWell revenue grew 22% but its operating profit fell to $243m from $305m.
Medicaid membership is up 103,600 (7%) this year and CenterWell primary care patients up 146,800 (30%); a new BlackRock primary-care JV replaced the old Welsh Carson JVs.

guidance.summary: Humana lifted its 2026 adjusted EPS floor to at least $9.50 from at least $9.00, still down on 2025's $17.14 because of the Star Ratings hit. GAAP EPS guidance moved to at least $15.09 from at least $6.52, mainly due to non-cash JV accounting items.

points: Humana now expects Medicare Advantage membership to grow again in 2027, after earlier pointing to flat or lower membership; early sign-ups are running ahead of its internal plan.
About 600,000 members were affected by 2027 plan exits, and management said winning many of them back has gone well.
The share of members in plans rated 4 stars or higher rises to 93% for 2027 from 41%, which should lift bonus payments from 2028.
No 2027 margin guidance was given; management repeated its goal of at least a 3% pre-tax margin in 2028 and expects higher Medicare Advantage profit in 2027.
Management credited broker relationships rather than richer benefits for the stronger enrolment.
call.source: Prepared management remarks (8-K Exhibit 99.3) and call coverage: Healthcare Dive, 6 Nov 2026
